name: grass_v1
doc: Grass as a field (design/plotter.md, "Fields"): a plotter covers a region with it, one tile per hex cell. cell is the per-cell functor (grass_cell_v1): from the cell's coordinates, ground, moisture, and the world's seed, which tile it shows, turned, scaled, and tinted; tile (grass_tile_v1) grows that tile, shared by every cell that picks it. The runtime runs the functor over a field's cells and draws the few distinct tiles instanced, swaying in the wind on the GPU; one cell as an instance (here, and in the stress tool) is the same pipeline.

params.name: species
params.doc: A grass: one genome from config/grass_v1_genomes/.

params.name: variant
params.doc: Which tile: the grass variants, then the plates (water, rock, sand, path, bare soil). In a field, the cell's choice sets it.

params.name: detail
params.doc: The finest level of detail the game allows: blades, fewer wider blades, tufts, a mat. The runtime picks coarser levels by size on screen.

params.name: cell_q
params.doc: The cell's axial coordinate q (a field passes a negative q as its two's-complement bits).

params.name: cell_r
params.doc: The cell's axial coordinate r (as cell_q).

params.name: moisture
params.doc: The cell's moisture: wetter grass grows taller and greener.

params.name: world_seed
params.doc: The world's seed: the same cell in another world chooses differently.

params.name: wind_speed
params.doc: The local wind; a field's blades sway on the GPU.

params.name: wind_heading
params.doc: Toward which the wind blows, from +Z toward +X.
